transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… mostly work stuff has been getting away from me. I don’t mean to, but I keep forgetting scheduled callbacks and work orders, and even little follow-ups I told people I’d handle. It’s kind of piled up, and my job asked me to come in before it messes up my chance to move up. I’m trying to get it under control.
How have you been feeling about yourself and your situation lately?

I’ve been trying to tell myself it’s fixable, you know, like I just need to get organized and catch up. But honestly… I feel pretty embarrassed. It’s turned into a bigger work problem than I want to admit. I’ve got a backlog now, tenants complaining, and there was a safety review put on my record.

I’m scared it’s going to cost me the promotion path I’ve been working toward. I don’t want to make it sound like I’m not trying, because I really am… it just feels like I keep letting things slip, and then I feel worse about myself.
Have you been feeling anxious about your work situation?

Yeah… I mean, I try not to overreact about it, but yes, I’ve been pretty anxious. It’s become a serious issue at work now — there’s a backlog, tenants have complained, and I’ve got that safety review on my record.

I’m worried it’s going to hurt my chance at moving up, and I really don’t want them thinking I don’t care or I’m not trying. I am trying. I just… I’m scared I’ve already made it look bad.
Have you been feeling worthless about yourself outside of the work situation?

Um… outside of work, I don’t know if I’d say “worthless.” That sounds a little strong. I mean, I definitely get down on myself sometimes, but mostly it’s tied to the work mess and feeling like I should be handling things better.

At home or just as a person… I guess I haven’t really noticed feeling worthless in general. I’m not sure if that answers it right.
Do you often feel guilty about things that aren't directly related to your work situation?

Not really, no… I mean, I feel bad if I forget something or let someone down, like anyone would, but I don’t think I’m walking around feeling guilty about things outside of work.

Most of that feeling is really tied to the job situation. I hope that makes sense.
Have you been feeling sad most of the time lately?

I don’t think it’s most of the time, no. I mean, I have moments where I feel low or discouraged, but I wouldn’t want to make it sound worse than it is.

It’s more like… I get upset when I think about how things are going, but I’m not just sad all day every day. At least, I don’t think so. Is that what you mean?
Do you often find yourself having trouble focusing or paying attention to details in your daily activities?

Yeah… I do, more than I probably want to admit. Like with the digital work orders, I’ll start reading the notes thinking I’ve got it, and then halfway through my mind just kind of slips off—like to the next noise or the next job—and then I realize I don’t actually know what I just looked at.

It’s embarrassing, because I’m trying to pay attention. I’m not ignoring it on purpose. But yes, that does happen.
Do you often feel guilty about things even after you've resolved them or made amends?

I don’t think so… not really. If I’ve apologized or fixed whatever it was, I might still feel a little awkward about it for a bit, but I don’t think I carry guilt around after that.

I mean, I hope I’m answering that right. It’s more like I just want things to be okay, but I don’t sit there punishing myself over it once it’s handled.
Do you often feel guilty about things in general?

In general? Um… I don’t think I’d say I feel guilty a lot, no. I can worry if I think I messed something up, and I don’t like feeling like I let someone down, but guilt isn’t something I’m carrying around all the time.

At least, not in the way I think you mean. Does that answer it okay?
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight recently?

Um… I don’t think so. Not anything significant that I’ve noticed, anyway.

My clothes seem to fit about the same, and I haven’t really been tracking the number on a scale. If you need an exact answer, I’m sorry—I’d have to check, but nothing has stood out to me.
Have you been feeling unusually tired lately?

Um… tired? I mean, I get tired like anyone, especially after work, but I don’t know that I’d call it unusual.

I haven’t noticed a big change or anything. If you mean like exhausted all the time, then… no, I don’t think so. Is that the kind of tired you mean?
Do you often find yourself fidgeting or feeling restless?

Um… fidgeting, maybe a little? I don’t know if I’d call it restless exactly.

I might shift around or mess with something in my hands sometimes, but I always thought that was pretty normal. It’s not like I’m trying to be disruptive or anything. Does that count as what you mean?
Have you found yourself enjoying things you used to like less often than before?

Um… I don’t think so, not in a big way.

I still like the things I like, I guess I just don’t always get around to them. But I wouldn’t say I’ve stopped enjoying them or anything. At least, nothing that really jumps out at me. Is that what you mean?
Have you noticed yourself taking less pleasure in activities or hobbies that you used to enjoy?

I don’t think so… not really. I mean, I still enjoy things when I actually do them. Sometimes I just don’t get to them, or I put them off, but it doesn’t feel like I’ve lost interest or that they don’t feel good anymore.

So I’d say no, unless there’s something specific you’re looking for?
Do you often feel like you're just not good enough at things in general?

Um… I don’t know. I guess I can be hard on myself sometimes, but I’m not sure I’d say I feel “not good enough” in general.

Like, I want to do things right, and if I mess something up I’ll think about it more than I probably should. But I try not to sit around thinking I’m just bad at everything. Does that answer it?
Do you often have difficulty remaining seated when you're supposed to be, like in meetings or other quiet activities?

Um… not really, I don’t think so. I mean, I can sit through meetings if I’m supposed to. I might shift around a little or want to get up, but I don’t usually have a problem actually staying seated.

I hope that answers what you’re asking.
Do you have difficulty completing tasks or projects because you lose focus or get distracted?

Yeah… I think that does happen. I don’t mean to, and I usually start out thinking I’m fine, but I’ll be doing a digital work order and reading the notes, and then halfway through my mind kind of slips off—like to another noise or the next job—and then I realize I don’t actually know what I just read.

So I do have to go back and reread things more than I’d like. I’m not trying to be careless, it just… happens. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Have you been experiencing significant distress or impairment in social, occupational, or other important areas of functioning as a result of your work situation?

Yeah… I mean, I wish I could say it’s not that bad, but it has started to become a real problem at work.

I’ve got a backlog now, and there have been tenant complaints. There was also a safety review put on my record, which is… honestly pretty embarrassing to say. I’m trying to handle it and not make excuses, but I’m scared it’s going to mess up the promotion path I’ve been working toward.

So, yes, I guess it is affecting things in a pretty significant way. Is that the kind of impairment you mean?
Have you experienced significant difficulties with organization and time management for as long as you can remember?

Yeah… I think so. I don’t want to make it sound like I was just a “problem kid” or anything, because I did okay in some ways, but I do remember teachers saying I was bright and then also saying I was always losing papers or missing parts of the directions.

Even back in grade school, I needed reminders to finish classwork and keep track of things. So… yes, I guess it’s been there a long time, before the work stress now. Does that answer it okay?
Do you have trouble with organization and time management in your personal life, outside of work?

Yeah… outside of work it happens too, though I guess the thing that really pushed it over the edge was work.

I keep forgetting scheduled callbacks, work orders, and even simple follow-ups I told people I’d do. I don’t want it to sound like I don’t care, because I do, but it piles up and then I’m behind before I realize how bad it’s gotten.

That’s actually what brought me in, honestly… work sent me here because it’s gotten bad enough that I could lose my chance at moving up. I’m embarrassed saying that, but yes, I do have trouble keeping track of things and managing time. Is that answering what you’re asking?
